system_limits.title: Limits & Performance
system_limits.subtitle: Upload size caps, rate limits, and worker pool size — the operational limits that used to be hardcoded and required a code change to tune.
system_limits.max_body_bytes_hint: Applies to every non-upload route. 0 = unlimited. Default: 1048576 (1 MB).
system_limits.max_upload_body_bytes_hint: Photos, images, and other files uploaded through a module (e.g. My Places, Recipes). 0 = unlimited. Default: 20971520 (20 MB).
system_limits.max_module_zip_bytes_hint: Downloaded when installing or updating a module. 0 = unlimited. Default: 104857600 (100 MB).
system_limits.max_opml_upload_bytes_hint: Feed list uploaded on the News admin page. 0 = unlimited. Default: 2097152 (2 MB).
system_limits.auth_rate_limit_max_label: Login rate limit (per IP per minute)
system_limits.auth_rate_limit_max_hint: Applies to the login and SSO callback endpoints. Must be greater than 0. Default: 20.
system_limits.ai_chat_ip_rate_limit_max_label: AI chat rate limit (per IP per minute)
system_limits.ai_chat_ip_rate_limit_max_hint: A coarse per-IP backstop on top of the per-user chat rate limit on the AI providers page. Must be greater than 0. Default: 30.
system_limits.global_rate_limit_max_label: Global rate limit (per user/IP per minute)
system_limits.global_rate_limit_max_hint: Applies to every route except the health check. Must be greater than 0. Default: 600.
system_limits.deno_conn_pool_size_hint: How many requests can run at once against a single module's worker process. Must be at least 1. Default: 4. Takes effect the next time each module restarts or updates — not immediately.
system_limits.geo_timeout_ms_hint: How long the browser waits for a location fix before giving up (e.g. when Wi-Fi-based positioning on a corporate network takes longer). Must be greater than 0. Default: 5 seconds.
system_limits.ai_provider_timeout_seconds_hint: HTTP timeout when fetching an AI provider's model list. Local/self-hosted models (e.g. Ollama) can take longer than cloud providers on modest hardware. Must be greater than 0. Default: 30 seconds.
system_limits.search_timeout_seconds_hint: Hard cap for a full web search round-trip, shared across every configured provider (SearXNG, Serper.dev, ...). A self-hosted SearXNG instance can need longer than a hosted API on modest hardware. Must be greater than 0. Default: 5 seconds.
system_limits.search_fallback_timeout_seconds_hint: How long the primary search provider gets before ModuLab gives up and tries the configured fallback provider (only relevant when one is set). Must be greater than 0. Default: 3 seconds.
system_limits.news_fetch_timeout_seconds_hint: HTTP timeout per feed fetch. Slow or flaky feeds otherwise get reported as unreachable prematurely. Must be greater than 0. Default: 10 seconds.
system_limits.store_sync_interval_seconds_hint: How often the module registry (official + community) is re-synced from GitHub in the background. Must be greater than 0. Default: 60 minutes (1 hour). A change takes effect on the next sync cycle.
system_limits.store_github_api_timeout_seconds_hint: HTTP timeout for GitHub API/raw-content fetches during a registry sync. Must be greater than 0. Default: 15 seconds.
system_limits.modules_install_download_timeout_seconds: Timeout for downloading a module's ZIP and checksum during install/update. A larger ZIP size cap can also need a longer window. Must be greater than 0. Default: 5 minutes.
system_limits.validation_error: Byte limits must be 0 or greater; rate limits and pool size must be greater than 0.
